title: ToolResult
description: The outcome of a ToolRequest, returned by the control-plane tool layer (ADR-0005 §4). A denial, a pending approval and a failure are all results — the runtime is told what happened rather than left to infer it from an error. Output is returned as data and is treated as UNTRUSTED by the agent runtime: it is rendered where the model protocol expects tool output, never where it expects platform instructions.

protocolVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: wire messages are versioned as a conversation. A mismatch fails fast at startup rather than being negotiated.

toolCallId.description: Correlates to the ToolRequest and to the TOOL_RESULT message that carries this result back to the model.

status.description: COMPLETED: executed, output present. DENIED: authorization refused; the reason is model-facing so the agent can adapt rather than retry blindly. AWAITING_APPROVAL: a human decision is required and the node attempt is suspended (ADR-0009). FAILED: attempted and failed. INDETERMINATE: the platform cannot establish whether the external effect occurred — distinct from FAILED because a blind retry of an EXTERNAL_WRITE could duplicate it (ADR-0005 §3).

output.description: Present when status is COMPLETED. Validated against the Tool's outputSchema before it is returned, so a misbehaving integration cannot inject an arbitrary shape into the model's context.

outputRef.description: Large output is stored as an artifact and referenced, rather than inlined into a message that then has to fit a context budget.

denial.description: Present when status is DENIED. The reason is deliberately model-facing and specific enough to be actionable, but never discloses what the grant would have permitted — that would turn a denial into an enumeration oracle for the agent's own boundary.

approvalId.description: Present when status is AWAITING_APPROVAL. Names the Approval the node attempt is suspended on.

sideEffectClass.description: Echoed from the Tool so the record of what happened does not depend on resolving the tool version later.

allOf.$comment: A denial with no reason is indistinguishable from a bug, and gives the agent nothing to adapt to.
Suspension must name the approval it is waiting on, or resume has nothing to key on.
ADR-0005 §3: a failure without a category cannot be classified as retryable or not, so the graph engine would have to guess.
Completed means there is output. Inline or by reference, but not neither: an agent handed an empty success has no way to distinguish it from a silent failure.
